title: How Mycelium handles your data
intro: The essentials in plain language — about one minute to read.

sections.heading: What stays on your device
bullets: Security keys so chats stay private
Everything is stored on your phone or computer — not on our servers

sections.heading: What does not go to a central server
bullets: We do not run a message archive you have to trust
Messages travel from device to device — we cannot read them

sections.heading: Who runs this app
paragraphs: Mycelium is open-source software — anyone can review the code.

footnote: When you connect with someone, their device may keep a copy of what you send — like any messenger between friends.
